== Acquisition ==
=== Crafting ===
{{main|Amalgamated Gemstone/Recipes}}
A [[Pile of Crystalline Dust]] can be combined in the [[Mystic Forge]] with 3 stacks of 3 [[crest]]s, [[Orb (gemstone)|orbs]] or [[doubloon]]s each; repeated stacks of the same item may be used, but do not have to be. The recipe will result in one amalgamated gemstone, with a rare chance of more (5 has been confirmed as a possibility). Alternately, a bulk recipe can be used with 5 [[Globs of Ectoplasm]] and 3 stacks of 25 crests, orbs or doubloons, producing 10 Amalgamated Gemstones, with a rare chance of getting 25 (approximately a 10% chance).

Additionally, the mystic forging of four [[universal upgrade]]s of {{rarity|master}} or higher quality has a rare chance of being promoted to an amalgamated gemstone (between 2-4%).

==== Sources ====
These [[Hero's Choice Chest]]s are obtained as daily final rewards of various [[meta event]]s in most zones from the [[expansion]]s. These are:
* All [[Heart of Thorns]] zones in the [[Heart of Maguuma#Locations|Heart of Maguuma]]
* The [[Path of Fire]] zones in [[Crystal Desert#Locations|Elona]]
** except the [[Desert Highlands]]
** but including the [[Domain of Vabbi]]
* All zones in [[Cantha#Locations|Cantha]]
** including [[Gyala Delve#Events|Gyala Delve]]
* All zones in the [[Horn of Maguuma#Locations|Horn of Maguuma]]
** excluding [[the Wizard's Tower]]
** Also [[Convergence: Outer Nayos]]
* [[Bava Nisos#Events|Bava Nisos]] and [[Convergence: Mount Balrior]]
Notably, completing all parts of the meta event in [[Inner Nayos]] rewards up to 3 [[Hero's Choice Chest|Hero's Choice Chests]] daily. Meta events in all other zones only reward one at most.

Unlike other Hero's Choice Chests, the [[Janthir Syntri: Hero's Choice Chest]] and [[Castora: Hero's Choice Chest]] do ''not'' contain a choice of an Amalgamated Gemstone.

This means a total of '''20''' Hero's Choice Chests and subsequently Amalgamated Gemstones can be acquired via these meta events per day.

== Notes ==
* Considering only the gemstone, crest or doubloon costs, the bulk recipe is cheaper: it rewards 10 amalgamated gemstones for 75 items, yielding 0.13 gemstones per upgrade, whereas the single recipe rewards 1 amalgamated gemstone for 9 items, yielding 0.11 gemstones per upgrade. This does not take into account the small chances at more than 1 or 10 amalgamated gemstones.
* A list of the individual trading post prices for all of the possible crest/doubloon/orb items can be found below:
